measurement_metadata.order: serial paired profiles; profile order alternates per application/mode/repetition
measurement_metadata.statement_reuse: Offline performance repetitions reuse each signed statement; one registry/device enrollment per bundle.
measurement_metadata.timing_boundary: setup includes public circuit/key setup and private preflight; prove includes witness generation/local constraint check/proof; verify excludes signature preflight
measurement_metadata.legacy_input_binding_migration: Prior rows checked against recorded protocol SHA-256 and original proof logs; all public/private file hashes first frozen at this resume.

environment_and_validation.build_profile: release, thin LTO, same native arm64 host/compiler/dependency lock; SIMD/AES field arithmetic enabled for both
environment_and_validation.performance_scope: Paired real 47-bit captures; 244 planned attempts under the measurement case_plan; excluded process warmups.
environment_and_validation.excluded_initial_runs: Portable-fallback initial campaign stopped at first very large trace, retained separately as measurements-portable-initial; no timings from it enter final optimized comparison. Initial sandbox timer diagnostic is also excluded.
environment_and_validation.performance_plan_revision: Reduced large-case repetitions during the first round, after observing their resource costs, before any second large-case sample; both profiles use the same per-case count.
environment_and_validation.resource_observation_limits: Read-only macOS sysctl snapshots during the large proof. No pre-campaign baseline was collected, so system swap usage cannot all be attributed to this process. Process peak RSS is recorded by time -l at completion and excludes swapped-out pages.

measurement_caveats.reason: Legacy Python parent was temporarily SIGSTOPed after journaling row 50 and resumed after the next child completed. Python harness wall_ms includes this wait. Binary phase times and the independently recorded time -l process_wall_ms do not include post-child controller suspension. Keep the original record; use process_wall_ms for process duration.

system_termination_evidence.source: macOS unified system log, queried with /usr/bin/log show
system_termination_evidence.saved_record_filter: Only the kernel memorystatus line identifying zkcfa-raw64 [93036] is saved; other returned lines are omitted.
system_termination_evidence.utc_conversion: The displayed local timestamp uses PDT (UTC-07:00) on 2026-09-07. Adding seven hours converts 08:00:03.877 to 15:00:03.877 UTC.
system_termination_evidence.conclusion: The kernel memorystatus subsystem reported killing this process as the largest compressed process. The proof workflow did not complete.
limitations: This record does not state a termination signal number.
The record does not establish a circuit-constraint or cryptographic-verification failure.
The logged 69101 MB value is preserved verbatim and is not interpreted as the maximum resident set size or peak memory footprint.

environment_and_validation.outcome_note: picojpeg complete raw64 r1 was terminated by macOS memorystatus at 15:00:03.877Z before producing a proof report. This is a resource-limited incomplete proof, not an observed circuit or cryptographic rejection.

excluded_unjournaled_log.reason: The legacy controller had completed the child but was paused before journaling its result at the first-round boundary. Resume preserves this unjournaled log and measures the same scheduled key under a new session-suffixed filename; this original log does not enter statistics.

environment_and_validation.source_snapshot_note: Current source_sha256 records the published tools and relation. The immutable initial runner snapshot and resumed runner session snapshot identify the actual controller revisions used. Proof binaries are separately bound by measurement metadata SHA-256.
environment_and_validation.performance_scope_note: Scheduling is taken from measurement metadata; the source environment snapshot may describe the initial plan.

aggregate_method: Within each application/mode/profile, use only successful samples and report its actual successful/expected count. Cross-application aggregates include only pairs where both profiles completed every planned repetition successfully. Take the median across those paired cases; ratio medians use per-case raw64/raw24 ratios, not ratios of aggregate medians. Missing and failed values remain null. A one-sample result is descriptive, not a variability estimate.

paired_capture_audit.comparison: address subtraction is used only in this read-only audit; no proof input is rewritten

resource_measurement_method: RSS and peak memory footprint are separate byte-valued Darwin time -l observations. process_wall_ms is the real elapsed field from time -l; wall_ms remains the original Python batch-parent observation and can include a paused parent waiting to collect an already finished child. Resource fields are read from each original log in memory; existing log hashes and journal RSS values are checked. Missing footprint is null/unavailable, never zero. Failed-attempt resource observations are retained here but excluded from timing aggregates.
